evidence.reference_title: Mutant surfactant A2 proteins associated with familial pulmonary fibrosis and lung cancer induce TGF-β1 secretion.
evidence.snippet: Inhibition of the TGF-β autocrine positive feedback loop by a pan-TGF-β-neutralizing antibody, a TGF-β receptor antagonist, or LTBP gene silencing results in the reversal of TGF-β-mediated epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition and cell death.

nodes.description: Lung epithelial cells expressing mutant SP-A2 die. TGF-beta blockade reverses the cell death, and cells expressing p.Asn207Tyr show raised apoptosis markers. Shown in cell lines, not in patient tissue.

evidence.reference_title: Identification and functional characterization of a novel surfactant protein A2 mutation (p.N207Y) in a Chinese family with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.
evidence.snippet: Functional research further revealed that the novel mutation affects the secretion of SFTPA2 protein and induces endoplasmic reticulum stress as well as apoptosis in A549 cells.

nodes.description: Retained mutant SP-A2 induces the unfolded protein response, with increased BiP and spliced XBP-1. This has been shown in A549 cells and primary type II cells expressing the mutant protein, not in patient tissue.

nodes.description: Antifibrotic drugs are used as in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis. In a Dutch surfactant-gene cohort, the seven patients with a surfactant-protein gene mutation who received six months of antifibrotic treatment had stable FVC. The result is not reported for SFTPA2 alone, and no trial has studied SFTPA2-related disease.

evidence.reference_title: Progressive Disease With Low Survival in Adult Patients With Pulmonary Fibrosis Carrying Surfactant-Related Gene Mutations: An Observational Study.
evidence.snippet: Subsequent analysis in the SRG group showed that patients with a surfactant mutation (n = 7) treated for 6 months with antifibrotic drugs showed stable lung function with a median change in FVC of +40 mL

nodes.description: Mutant SP-A2 raises expression of TGF-beta1 and of the latent TGF-beta binding proteins LTBP-1 and LTBP-4, and epithelial cells secrete latent TGF-beta1 that acts in an autocrine and paracrine loop. Lavage fluid from heterozygous carriers contained more TGF-beta1 than controls.

evidence.reference_title: Mutant surfactant A2 proteins associated with familial pulmonary fibrosis and lung cancer induce TGF-β1 secretion.
evidence.snippet: Expression of mutant SP-A2 in lung epithelial cells leads to secretion of latent TGF-β1, which is capable of autocrine and paracrine signaling.

evidence.reference_title: Mutant surfactant A2 proteins associated with familial pulmonary fibrosis and lung cancer induce TGF-β1 secretion.
evidence.snippet: Expression of the mutant SP-A2 proteins leads to the coordinated increase in gene expression of TGF-β1 and two TGF-β1-binding proteins, LTBP-1 and LTBP-4; expression of the latter is necessary for secretion of this cytokine.

evidence.reference_title: Mutant surfactant A2 proteins associated with familial pulmonary fibrosis and lung cancer induce TGF-β1 secretion.
evidence.snippet: Here we show that bronchoalveolar lavage fluid from humans heterozygous for a missense mutation in the gene encoding surfactant protein (SP)-A2 (SFTPA2) contains more TGF-β1 than control samples.

nodes.description: Transplantation is the treatment for end-stage disease. In a French multicentre series of adults with surfactant-gene ILD, which included seven SFTPA2 carriers, median survival after transplantation was 8.6 years. Lung cancer occurred before and after transplantation, so screening is advised.

evidence.reference_title: Outcome of lung transplantation for adults with interstitial lung disease associated with genetic disorders of the surfactant system.
evidence.snippet: 20 patients carrying mutations in SFTPA1 (n=5), SFTPA2 (n=7) or SFTPC (n=8) were included.

evidence.reference_title: Outcome of lung transplantation for adults with interstitial lung disease associated with genetic disorders of the surfactant system.
evidence.snippet: Lung transplantation in adults with interstitial lung disease associated with genetic disorders of surfactant system may be a valid therapeutic option.

evidence.reference_title: Outcome of lung transplantation for adults with interstitial lung disease associated with genetic disorders of the surfactant system.
evidence.snippet: Immunosuppressive protocol was not changed for these patients, and close lung cancer screening is needed before and after transplantation.

nodes.description: Lung adenocarcinoma co-segregated with fibrosis in the founding families and is common among adult SFTPA2 carriers, but some carriers found in an unselected IPF cohort had no lung cancer. Bronchiolar metaplasia was noted on their explants and biopsies. Smoking strongly raises the odds of cancer in surfactant-gene carriers. No frequency is given because the counts come from referral cohorts.

evidence.reference_title: Genetic defects in surfactant protein A2 are associated with pulmonary fibrosis and lung cancer.
evidence.snippet: Another rare mutation in SFTPA2 was identified in another family with IPF and lung cancer.

evidence.reference_title: High risk of lung cancer in surfactant-related gene variant carriers.
evidence.snippet: We identified 99 SRG adult variant carriers (SFTPA1 (n=18), SFTPA2 (n=31), SFTPC (n=24), ABCA3 (n=14) and NKX2-1 (n=12)), including 20 (20.2%) with lung cancer (SFTPA1 (n=7), SFTPA2 (n=8), SFTPC (n=3), NKX2-1 (n=2) and ABCA3 (n=0)).

evidence.reference_title: High risk of lung cancer in surfactant-related gene variant carriers.

evidence.reference_title: Rare surfactant-related variants in familial and sporadic pulmonary fibrosis.

nodes.description: Mutant SP-A2 is made but forms fewer dimers and trimers, is partly insoluble, is unstable to proteolysis, and is degraded by ER-associated degradation instead of being secreted. In patient lung tissue the SP-A staining pattern is altered. Total SP-A in bronchoalveolar lavage of heterozygous carriers is normal, so the disease is not attributed to a lack of secreted SP-A.

evidence.reference_title: Surfactant protein A2 mutations associated with pulmonary fibrosis lead to protein instability and endoplasmic reticulum stress.
evidence.snippet: We show that, in contrast with all other SP-A2 variants, the mutant proteins are not secreted into the medium with wild-type SP-A isoforms, form fewer intracellular dimer and trimer oligomers, are partially insoluble in 0.5% Nonidet P-40 lysates of transfected A549 cells, and demonstrate greater protein instability in chymotrypsin proteolytic digestions.

evidence.reference_title: Surfactant protein A2 mutations associated with pulmonary fibrosis lead to protein instability and endoplasmic reticulum stress.
evidence.snippet: Both the G231V and F198S mutant SP-A2 proteins are destroyed via the ER-association degradation pathway.

evidence.reference_title: Surfactant protein A2 mutations associated with pulmonary fibrosis lead to protein instability and endoplasmic reticulum stress.
evidence.snippet: Human bronchoalveolar wash samples from individuals who are heterozygous for the G231V mutation have similar levels of total SP-A as normal family members, which suggests that the mechanism of disease does not involve an overt lack of secreted SP-A but instead involves an increase in ER stress of resident type II alveolar epithelial cells.
